question: Balancing 40% Q3 revenue growth against -$136M to -$986M owner FCF, a $1.0B ATM shelf, and a Stage 4 break below $78.00, what is our exact New Capital Verdict, Holding Action, and Redeployment Plan?

epigraph.quote: When both your technical stop and your options invalidation floor break in the same week inside a market downtrend, discipline means executing the exit rather than inventing a new excuse to hold.
epigraph.author: Portfolio Risk & Synthesis Desk

web_blocks.title: Steelmanning Both Sides: AI Pull-Through vs. Lease-and-Dilution Gravity

web_blocks.html: The Bull Steelman: Bulls argue that November's -64% selloff has created a mispriced AI cloud platform [1][23]. Q3 2026 revenue grew 40% YoY to $321.2M, ARR reached $1,285M on a record $160M net-new ARR, and RPO jumped 13x YoY to $799.7M [1][2]. Because 90% of AI customers also buy Core Cloud and S&M fell to 8% of sales, bulls believe hitting 60%+ FY2027 revenue growth ($1.94B) at ~51% gross margins without ATM draws drives a snapback toward $96.00 [1][2].

The Bear Steelman: Bears counter that headline growth masks severe lease leverage and share dilution [2][26]. Basic shares jumped +28.2% YTD from 91.95M to 117.92M, with Q4 diluted guidance at 128.5M midpoint [1][2]. A new $1.0B ATM shelf could add +14.68M shares to 143.18M at $66.76, while Q3 SBC rose +82% YoY to $36.05M [2][26]. On November 19, CFO Matt Steinfort filed Form 144 to sell 75,000 shares [28]. Top-51 accounts represent 30% of ARR ($386M), NDR disclosures vanished, and finance leases hit $923.6M PV ($250M/yr due 2027–2029) [1][2]. Off balance sheet sit $2.96B in uncommenced colocation leases and a $785M MUFG facility [2][27]. With -$136M to -$986M economic owner FCF and Stage 4 selling, 4.0x Bear compression plus leases and ATM shares points to $26.82 [2][23].

web_blocks.intro: DOCN sits in Stage 4 (CAP_REJECTED) and carries a -11.3% expected return ($59.19 EV). Because it also fails our owner cash-flow gate, new equity sizing is 0.0% ($0) at TIER_0. Any conditional valuation reset band sits far below spot at $28.00–$35.00.

web_blocks.title: Held Position Audit: Why EXIT_IMMEDIATELY Replaces EXIT_ON_BOUNCE

web_blocks.html: As of November 20, 2026, total portfolio NAV is $75,110.60 ($57,691.82 equities, $14,878.43 options, $2,540.35 cash). The portfolio holds 90.745138 DOCN shares across two brokers. Charles Schwab holds 61.3008 shares ($5,399.98 cost basis, $4,092.44 market value, +$2,427.79 realized P&L). Robinhood holds 29.444338 shares ($3,500.00 cost basis, $1,965.70 market value).

Combined equity cost basis is $8,899.98 (~$98.08/sh) against $6,058.14 market value. That represents an unrealized loss of -$2,841.84 (-31.93%) and an 8.07% equity weight. We also hold 4x DOCN 2027-06-17 $150 Call LEAPS (DOCN270617C00150000, $3,720.00 MV, 206 DTE) [34]. Combined DOCN exposure equals $9,778.14, or 13.02% of net worth [34].

Last week's EXIT_ON_BOUNCE plan relied on a 4-hour bounce above $86.01 and a hard close stop at $78.00. Both the $78.00 equity stop and $80.00 LEAPS floor broke on November 20, while Schwab added 12.68 shares into the drop. Comparing HOLD vs. EXIT on the 4x $150 LEAPS is clear: holding needs a +124.7% rally in 206 days against $1.0B ATM supply, risking full $3,720.00 theta wipeout [34]. Closing locks in $3,720.00 cash immediately [34]. Our binding action moves to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 90.745138 common shares plus an immediate CLOSE on all 4x June 2027 $150 LEAPS [23][34][35].

web_blocks.title: Pre-Mortem: What If DOCN Stages an Oversold Dead-Cat Bounce After We Exit?
paragraphs: With 10.99% short float and Daily RSI at 31.04, DOCN could bounce 10%–15% toward $75.00 after we sell [23][25]. Accepting that risk is the cost of honoring a broken $78.00 stop and cutting a 13.02% Stage 4 weight in a Downtrend. Waiting after a -13.40% high-volume breakdown risks riding a second leg down toward $26.82.

web_blocks.title: Redeployment Plan: 100% Cash Reserve in a Downtrend Regime

web_blocks.html: Exiting all 90.745138 common shares frees roughly $6,058.14. Closing the 4x LEAPS frees another $3,720.00, totaling ~$9,778.14. Meanwhile, the S&P 500 sits in a 10-distribution-day Downtrend (38.8% above 50-DMA, 1/11 sectors above 20-DMA), and cash is just $2,540.35 (3.38% NAV) [35]. We therefore deploy 100% of freed proceeds into Cash / T-Bills, lifting liquidity to ~$8,598–$12,318 (11.4%–16.4% NAV).

We benchmark three verified November 20 Stage 2 comparators at 0% allocation for opportunity-cost tracking [33]. On our shortlist, Eli Lilly (LLY, $1,347.11 close) holds Stage 2 (BUY_AT_CMP_NO_FOMO) with a $1,282.61–$1,321.67 zone, $1,158.67 stop, and $1,660.00 target (2.08:1 zone-top R:R; 1.66:1 CMP R:R) [33]. Also on our shortlist, AbbVie (ABBV, $286.20 close) holds Stage 2 with a $277.05–$285.49 zone, $249.53 stop, and $340.00 target (1.52:1 zone-top R:R) [33]. Outside the shortlist, Stryker (SYK, $310.00 close) holds Stage 2 (33.02x P/E, 16.02% ROE, 24.56% OPM) with a $299.24–$308.36 zone, $290.38 stop, and $342.96 Finviz target (1.92:1 zone-top R:R) [33]. All three equity benchmarks stay unfunded at 0% until market breadth exits Downtrend.

Binding Execution & Reversal Triggers: Execute EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 90.745138 common shares (61.3008 Schwab + 29.444338 Robinhood) at next open (~$66.76). Simultaneously CLOSE all 4x 2027-06-17 $150 Call LEAPS (DOCN270617C00150000, $3,720.00 MV) [34]. New equity stays REJECTED (TIER_0) until five gates clear together: price resets into $28.00–$35.00, a multi-month base reclaims a rising 30W SMA, GAAP GM hits ≥ 51%, post-lease/post-SBC owner FCF turns positive with NDR > 100%, and ATM sales stay at zero [1][2][26].

book_paragraphs: Synthesis is where forensic accounting, valuation arithmetic, and tape discipline converge into an unambiguous order sheet. Looking honestly at both sides of DigitalOcean on November 20, 2026, the operational achievements are real: 40% third-quarter revenue growth, $1,285 million in ARR, $799.7 million in RPO, and 8% sales-and-marketing efficiency. Yet the financial cost of achieving that growth—50.1% GAAP gross margins, $923.6 million in finance leases, $2.96 billion in uncommenced colocation obligations, 28.2% year-to-date share dilution, a $1.0 billion ATM shelf, and -$136 million to -$986 million in annual economic cash burn—prevents DigitalOcean from clearing our valuation or capital-efficiency hurdles.

Assigning a 20% probability to our $96.00 bull case (7.0x FY2027E sales), 45% to our $68.00 base case (5.5x FY2027E sales), and 35% to our $26.82 bear case (4.0x FY2027E sales of $1.5125 billion after +$1.00 billion in lease draws and +14.68 million ATM shares) yields a 12-month probability-weighted expected value of $59.19—a negative 11.3% expected return from today's $66.76 close. Combined with a broken Stage 4 weekly chart, new capital is REJECTED at Conviction Tier 0 on TREND, VALUATION, and CASH_FLOW.

For the portfolio's existing stake, the past week's price action demands decisive action rather than renewed patience. Across Schwab and Robinhood, we hold 90.745138 common shares worth $6,058.14 (cost basis $8,899.98, unrealized loss -$2,841.84) alongside four June 2027 $150 Call LEAPS worth $3,720.00—a massive 13.02% combined exposure to a Stage 4 stock inside a market Downtrend. Because Friday's crash broke both our $80.00 LEAPS floor and our $78.00 common-equity hard stop without a 4-hour reversal, we upgrade our holding action from EXIT_ON_BOUNCE to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY.

Our portfolio verdict leaves zero ambiguity for either existing capital or marginal dollars during a ten-distribution-day market Downtrend. We hold 90.745138 shares of DigitalOcean across Charles Schwab (61.3008 shares) and Robinhood (29.444338 shares) worth $6,058.14 against an $8,899.98 cost basis, representing 8.07% of our $75,110.60 consolidated portfolio net worth. Because shares are locked in a Stage 4 breakdown carrying a CAP_REJECTED timing ceiling alongside negative owner cash flow, the mandatory holding action is EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 90.745138 shares, paired with closing all four DOCN270617C00150000 call contracts ($3,720.00 market value).

One hundred percent of freed proceeds remain in USD cash earning 4.76% to 5.04% until market breadth recovers above its 50-day moving average. Should capital eventually rotate once breadth repairs, higher-ranked Stage 2 shortlist benchmarks—such as Eli Lilly at $1,347.11 (2.08-to-1 support asymmetry) and AbbVie at $286.20 (1.52-to-1 support asymmetry)—command zero allocation today solely due to regime preservation, while NBIS and CoreWeave remain non-shortlist peer benchmarks. For DigitalOcean to ever shed REJECTED (TIER_0), every one of five structural AND-gates must clear together: positive post-lease, post-SBC free cash flow; GAAP gross margin at or above 51%; restored Core Cloud Net Dollar Retention above 100%; zero ATM share issuance; and a confirmed Stage 1 base reclaim below $42.37.

book_subsections.title: Why EXIT_IMMEDIATELY Beats Waiting for a Bounce
paragraphs: Switching from EXIT_ON_BOUNCE to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY is never emotionally easy after a 13.40% single-day drop, because selling at $66.76 feels like capitulating into oversold RSI (31.04). Yet rule-based risk management exists precisely for moments when stops are violated. On November 13, our bounce-exit plan was explicitly conditioned on a strict daily-close hard stop at $78.00 and an $80.00 LEAPS invalidation level. Both thresholds failed on November 20 on 1.82x relative volume, and the 4-hour momentum turn vanished.

Even more troubling, portfolio records show that the Schwab account expanded from 48.621 shares to 61.3008 shares during the slide, lifting total DOCN equity and LEAPS risk to 13.02% of our $75,110.60 net worth while cash dwindled to $2,540.35 (3.38% of NAV). Weighing HOLD versus EXIT on the four June 2027 $150 Call LEAPS confirms the same urgency: holding requires a +124.7% rally in 206 days and risks total theta wipeout, while closing salvages $3,720.00 and eliminates second-leg downside risk toward $26.82.

book_subsections.title: 100% Cash Redeployment and Stage 2 Benchmarks on Deck
paragraphs: Exiting our common shares (~$6,058.14) and LEAPS ($3,720.00) frees roughly $9,778.14 in total capital. With the S&P 500 trapped in a 10-distribution-day Downtrend where only 38.8% of stocks hold above their 50-day moving average and just one of eleven sectors holds above its 20-day average, we deploy 100% of freed proceeds into Cash and Treasury bills rather than forcing money into equities.

We still benchmark three verified Stage 2 comparators at 0% allocation so the portfolio stays prepared for the next rally: Eli Lilly (LLY at $1,347.11; support $1,282.61–$1,321.67, stop $1,158.67, base target $1,660.00, 2.08:1 zone-top R:R) and AbbVie (ABBV at $286.20; support $277.05–$285.49, stop $249.53, base target $340.00, 1.52:1 zone-top R:R) from our active shortlist, plus outside Stage 2 benchmark Stryker (SYK at $310.00; support $299.24–$308.36, stop $290.38, Finviz target $342.96, 1.92:1 zone-top R:R). Until market breadth recovers, Cash is our highest-conviction position.

book_subsections.title: Decision Reversal Conditions and Final Portfolio Discipline
paragraphs: Every rejection in our framework must specify exact, falsifiable conditions that would restore investability. DigitalOcean would earn a fresh re-underwriting only if five milestones occur together: price resets into the $28.00–$35.00 valuation watch band (reflecting diluted, lease-adjusted fair value); the stock completes a multi-month accumulation base and reclaims a rising 30-week moving average; management restores Net Dollar Retention disclosures above 100%; GAAP gross margin holds at or above 51%; and operating cash flow funds all hardware/lease additions plus SBC with zero ATM share issuance.

Until all five milestones materialize in audited Form 10-Q filings and on the price chart, protecting principal takes precedence over hoping for a neocloud rebound. Selling all 90.745138 common shares and closing our four June 2027 $150 Call LEAPS converts a 13.02% Stage 4 risk concentration into clean, dry-powder liquidity.
